historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mid-path base-case revenue growth (FY2027-FY2030), anchored on subscription revenue (+13.3% FY2025, +5.3% H1 FY2026) blended with a flat-to-slightly-growing social entertainment book; the equity CAGR is not a usable forward proxy here
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR of 18.1% diverges by far more than 30% from revenue 3yr CAGR of -4.8% and owner-FCF 3yr CAGR of -4.4%. The equity growth is retained profit plus the 678m one-off deferred-tax credit on a book that was still recovering from pre-IPO losses; it says nothing about forward operating growth and was not used.
historical_growth.notes: FY2020 book equity (-5,306.8m, pre-IPO with convertible preferred shares as liabilities), FY2020-FY2022 EPS and FY2020 owner FCF are negative, so the 5-year EPS/equity/FCF CAGRs and 3-year EPS CAGR are undefined and reported null. Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC; interest already outside OCF): FY2020 -1,011.9, FY2021 -1,205.1, FY2022 1,709.9, FY2023 99.2, FY2024 1,632.3, FY2025 1,495.1, H1 FY2026 406.8 (TTM 1,441.2). FY2022 was flattered by live-streaming prepayments and FY2023 depressed by a large working-capital outflow, so the 3yr owner-FCF CAGR (-4.4%) is noisy; the owner-FCF CAGR is only slightly below the reported-FCF CAGR (-4.0%) because SBC has been shrinking (257m FY2021 -> 112m FY2025), i.e. SBC is not eating the growth here. Revenue has been flat for two years as the deliberate wind-down of social entertainment (5,293 FY2022 -> 1,765 FY2025) offset online-music growth (3,699 -> 5,994).

scenario_narratives.base: NetEase Cloud Music settles into its new place as China's #3 music app by MAU but keeps the most engaged, most music-centric user base (DAU/MAU >30%, 1M+ independent artists). Subscription revenue compounds mid-single digits as the subscriber base widens and ARPPU dilutes; the social entertainment book, deliberately shrunk from 5.3bn to 1.8bn, stops falling. Gross margin keeps grinding up with mix while S&M stays elevated to defend share against Qishui, so pre-SBC EBITDA margin expands roughly half a point a year from 20.5% to 24%. The cash-tax shelter from historical losses is consumed over five to six years and the cash rate normalises to ~16%. Buybacks continue; the count is held flat with SBC fully expensed. Group revenue grows 3-4.5% then fades to 2.5%.
scenario_narratives.bull: Paid-music penetration in China keeps rising and NetEase captures its share: subscriber growth re-accelerates, member-tier pricing (dress-up, artist offerings, hi-res content) ends the ARPPU dilution, and AI-driven recommendation lifts engagement enough that Qishui's traffic advantage does not translate into subscription share. Non-exclusive label economics post the 2021 antitrust remedy let gross margin reach ~45%; S&M normalises once the entrant's growth slows; pre-SBC EBITDA matures at 27%. Revenue grows 6-7.5% through FY2030 and the market re-rates the operating business from the ~2x owner FCF it is paying today.
scenario_narratives.bear: ByteDance does to music what it did to short video: Qishui, already ahead on MAU, uses Douyin's distribution to pull younger listeners and then paying users; NetEase's subscription growth stalls and ARPPU keeps diluting while the live-streaming book resumes declining. Labels, now 29% of COGS and consolidating their leverage, extract higher royalties at renewals; marketing spend stays high; pre-SBC EBITDA compresses to 17%. Revenue falls ~8% over FY2027-30 and then grows 1-2%. The business still generates over RMB 1bn of owner FCF a year, so most of the bear value is the RMB 13bn of cash and deposits -- and the live question is whether minority holders ever see it (61% founder control, onshore cash, no dividend).

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on the operating business plus RMB 13.1bn of cash, deposits and wealth-management products at face, with SBC fully expensed, the share count held flat, interest income kept out of the flows (it is already outside OCF by presentation) and the cash-tax rate ramped off the loss-carryforward shelter. The FY2025 headline profit is ignored: the model builds from operating profit, so the 678m one-off deferred-tax credit never enters the base. Net cash is roughly RMB 62 per share (~HK$73), i.e. the market is paying only a small fraction of one year's owner FCF for the operating business -- or, equivalently, applying a steep discount to onshore cash controlled by a 61% holder. The house method takes cash at face and leaves that discount to the reader; the sensitivity to it is stated below rather than buried in the WACC.
key_risks_to_valuation: Trapped-cash / governance discount: ~80% of the market cap is cash and deposits held largely in PRC subsidiaries under 61% founder/NetEase control with no dividend. A 10% dividend-withholding haircut on repatriation would be ~RMB 1.3bn (~HK$7/share); a market that refuses to credit the cash at all would value the shares near the operating-business-only figure (weighted IV less ~HK$73). The H1 FY2026 buyback of RMB 856m is evidence the cash does come back; the flat FY2025 buyback is evidence it comes back at management's pace.
Competitive share loss to ByteDance's Qishui Music and Tencent Music's scale: the bear path cuts revenue ~8% and EBITDA margin to 17%; a faster or deeper loss than that is not modelled.
Content cost inflation at label renewals (top-5 suppliers 29.3% of cost of revenue); each 1pp of gross margin is ~RMB 80m of EBITDA, ~RMB 5/share capitalised.

Cash-tax normalisation: the model ramps to 16%; if the HNTE 15% rate lapses or Pillar Two top-up grows, 20-25% applies (the bear case). Conversely the DTA shelter could last longer than the ~5-6 years assumed.
FX: value is built in CNY and quoted in HKD at 1.1754; a 5% CNY depreciation is ~5% off every HKD figure. The rate is dated and must be refreshed with the price.

Discount-rate judgment: 10% WACC embeds ~1.8pp of structural China/VIE premium over pure CAPM. Each 1pp of WACC is worth roughly HK$10-12/share in the base case (see sensitivity grid); the required-return table shows what IRR today's price implies.

Fiscal-period overlap: the growth path compounds from FY2025 while the balance sheet is 30 June 2026, so roughly one half-year of owner FCF (~RMB 400m, ~HK$2/share) is in both the cash pile and Y1 -- partly offset by end-of-year discounting of a FY2026 flow that is mostly already earned.

data_sources.financials: research/9899.HK/Reports/9899.HK_Metrics.csv and core_metrics/kpis (financial-parser, 2026-10-24); 9899.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (P&L p.5562-5569, tax note 7597-7645, D&A 8615-8616, cash flow 5820-5841, SBC 603); 9899.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt (P&L 1125-1154, balance sheet 1200-1267, cash flow 1367-1399, EPS note 1825-1856, treasury shares 2132, FVTPL note 1589-1630).

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 (year to 31 Dec 2025) revenue, RMB m, audited. Y1 of the path is FY2026. H1 FY2026 revenue was 3,958.7 (+3.4% YoY); TTM to Jun-2026 is 7,891.0.
inputs.share_count_basis: 210,332,516 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (interim report note 10 / p.664). This INCLUDES the 4,960,230 treasury shares held by the Trustee for the share award scheme, which will be delivered to employees as awards vest -- so every past grant is counted as fully dilutive. Shares outstanding ex-treasury were ~205.4m and the treasury-method dilutive effect in the H1 FY2026 diluted-EPS calc was 1.41m (210,369,897 diluted vs 208,961,138 basic weighted), so 210.33m is the conservative ceiling. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). 7,172,714 shares repurchased in H1 FY2026 were cancelled on 12 June 2026 (count fell from 213.5m at FY2025). On-market buybacks (~HK$15m tranches) continued after 30 June; those reduce the count slightly from this figure.
inputs.cash_composition_note: 30 June 2026 balance sheet (RMB m): cash and cash equivalents 2,407.271 + current bank deposits 9,444.452 + financial assets at FVTPL 1,278.874 (wealth management products, note 4.2 -- principal-protected-style short-dated bank WMPs, where the RMB 1.4bn of long-term bank deposits that matured in H1 FY2026 was redeployed) = 13,130.597. Restricted cash nil. Equity-method investments of 46.1 and amounts due from group companies of 29.7 are excluded (immaterial). No borrowings; total_debt is lease liabilities only (0.399 non-current + 0.434 current). Deferred income tax assets of 691.2 are NOT cash and are handled through the cash-tax ramp, not the bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, adjusted-operating-profit reconciliation and consolidated cash flow statement: 'Equity-settled share-based payments' RMB 111,797k (FY2024: 138,571k). No cash taxes on net-share settlement are disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0 in every year), so the combined figure equals the add-back. H1 FY2026: 50,420k (1.27% of revenue).
inputs.interest_income_note: Finance income was RMB 445.9m in FY2025 (190.1m in H1 FY2026) and the matching asset (13.1bn of cash, deposits and WMPs) IS added to EV in the bridge. No further deduction from reported FCF is needed because this filer presents 'Interest received' (463.5m FY2025) inside INVESTING activities, so operating cash flow and therefore reported_fcf already exclude it. Check: FY2025 OCF 1,618.1 = operating profit 1,622.0 + SBC 111.8 + D&A 12.6 - working capital 121.6 - income taxes paid 6.6. Deducting the 445.9 again would strip the income twice. The excluded-income / matching-asset rule is therefore satisfied: income out of the flows (by presentation), asset in the bridge.
inputs.buyback_note: TTM to 30 June 2026: RMB 856.1m repurchased in H1 FY2026 (financing activities), after only 1.9m in FY2025. The June 2025 mandate (up to 21.74m shares) is being used; ~3.3% of the count has been retired. The flat count is funded by the repurchaser, not a modelling convention.
inputs.fx_note: CNYHKD=X 1.1754 (1 CNY = 1.1754 HKD), Yahoo Finance, 2026-10-23T19:32Z. Direction is model -> quote: per-share values are computed in CNY (the statements' and flows' currency) and MULTIPLIED by 1.1754 to reach the HKD quote. 9899.HK has no dual listing or ADR for a direct parity check, so the rate was triangulated: USDHKD 7.8419 / USDCNY 6.6697 = 1.1757 vs 1.1754 direct (0.03% tie, same date). The filer labels its currency RMB; CNY is the ISO code. refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate -- re-check it on any later refresh.
inputs.price_note: Regular-session close, not an after-hours print. The close was +10.8% on the day (prior four closes 87.7 / 85.9 / 85.3 / 82.6), so the print is volatile; the 52-week range is 80.55-261.2 and the stock is ~49% down YTD.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8% + beta 1.2 x China equity risk premium ~5.3% (mature-market 4.3% + country premium) = ~8.2% pure CAPM, plus a ~1.8pp structural premium for the VIE/contractual-arrangement structure, the 61% founder/NetEase control (minority holders cannot force cash return) and the onshore location of the cash. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity = 10.0%. Competitive risk (Qishui Music/ByteDance, Tencent Music scale) and operating risk are charged in the scenario paths and the bear weight, NOT in the WACC, and the same 10.0% is used in all three scenarios -- risk is charged once, in the place it belongs.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt: lease liabilities (RMB 0.833m at 30 June 2026) sit in total_debt/net_debt; lease principal (0.9m per half-year) is NOT deducted from the flows; right-of-use renewal is covered by the capex % line. Leases are 0.02% of revenue -- immaterial under either treatment, but one treatment is stated.
inputs.nci_treatment: None required. NCI was eliminated during FY2025 (the minority's share of profit was -2.4m in FY2025 and nil in H1 FY2026; the NCI equity line is nil at 30 June 2026). Flows are 100% attributable.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 1: operating company, consumer internet / subscription). The net-cash-rich balance sheet does not change the route -- it is handled through the bridge (cash at face, interest income out of the flows) -- and the business is a single operating segment, so no sum-of-parts. First valuation of this ticker; no prior Drivers/DCF, no MEMORY entry. Normalisation: FY2025 reported net profit of 2,748 is inflated by a 678.1m net deferred-tax credit (gross DTA recognition 746.7m less 61.0m Pillar Two top-up); the model does not use net income -- it builds from operating profit (1,622.0, 20.9% margin) + SBC + D&A, so the one-off never enters the base. Adjusted (pre-SBC) EBITDA FY2025 = 1,622.0 + 111.8 + 12.6 = 1,746.4 = 22.5% of revenue; H2 FY2025 was 21.2% and H1 FY2026 20.3% (S&M stepped up 163 -> 295m against Qishui; other income fell 85 -> 11m), so Y1 starts at 20.5%, not at the FY2025 full-year figure. Cash tax: statutory 25% EIT, the main PRC operating subsidiary is HNTE at 15% from 2025 (renewal every 3 years), FY2025 tax reconciliation implies a ~14.5% underlying book rate before the DTA credit; cash taxes paid were 6.6m FY2025 and 1.2m H1 FY2026 because cumulative tax losses (DTA 691.2m at 30 June 2026, utilised ~55m per half) shelter current tax. The shelter is finite (~5-6 years at the current burn) so the cash tax rate RAMPS 5% -> 16% rather than perpetuating the near-zero rate. Working capital: deferred revenue (contract liabilities) grew +188m in FY2025 while receivables and prepaid royalties also grew; net WC was a 122m outflow in FY2025 and ~340m in H1 FY2026, so capture is set low (10% base) despite the subscription model. D&A and capex are ~0.15% of revenue each (PP&E depreciation 10.9 + ROU 1.7 = 12.6; capex 11.2 in FY2025, 3.7 in FY2024; management states no material capex plans). Horizon 10 years because the EBITDA margin is still ramping through year 5.
inputs.normalized_earnings_note: FY2025 pre-tax profit 2,067.7 less finance income 445.9 = operating-level pre-tax 1,621.9; at a normal 15% rate that is ~1,380 of normalised operating NOPAT (vs 2,748 reported net profit, 2,860 'adjusted net profit'). Normalised FY2025 EPS ex the DTA credit ~ RMB 9.70 vs 12.87 reported.

bear.growth_rationale: Qishui Music (ByteDance), having passed NetEase on MAU in early 2026, keeps converting Douyin traffic into paying users; NetEase subscriber growth stalls, ARPPU keeps diluting, social entertainment resumes its decline. Revenue falls ~8% peak-to-trough over FY2027-FY2030, then grows 1-2%.
bear.margin_rationale: Label concentration (top-5 suppliers 29.3% of COGS, up from 25.7%) turns into cost inflation at renewals, and the FY2026 S&M step-up becomes permanent; pre-SBC EBITDA compresses to 17% before partial recovery to 18%. SBC % drifts up on retention grants against a smaller revenue base.
bear.tax_rationale: HNTE status lapses at a renewal or Pillar Two top-up grows; cash rate ramps to 20%.
bear.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 10%/1.5% = 11.9x binds just below the 12x cap. The scenario does not approach the zero floor: the business stays solidly cash-generative even here, which is why the net cash pile dominates the bear value.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +3% tracks H1 (+3.4%). Subscription revenue keeps growing mid-single digits as subscribers rise and ARPPU dilutes; social entertainment stabilises near the current ~1.8bn run-rate after the FY2024-25 wind-down; group growth peaks at 4.5% and fades to 2.5% terminal (China nominal GDP-ish).
base.margin_rationale: Pre-SBC EBITDA 20.5% in FY2026 (H1 FY2026 20.3%, H2 FY2025 21.2%), then +0.5pp/yr as gross margin keeps rising with mix (33.7% FY2024 -> 35.7% FY2025 -> 37.2% H1 FY2026; ~41-42% by maturity) while S&M stays elevated at ~7% of revenue to defend share. Matures at 24% (~22.5% EBIT margin after SBC), below Tencent Music's ~25-30% operating margin, reflecting the scale gap.
base.tax_rationale: Cash rate ramps from ~5% (DTA utilisation; 1.2m paid in H1 FY2026) to 16% as the 691m DTA is consumed over ~5-6 years; 16% long-run blends the 15% HNTE rate on the main subsidiary with 25% on the others and a small Pillar Two top-up.
base.wc_rationale: 10% capture of the YoY revenue increase: subscription prepayments are a genuine inflow but receivables (1,068 -> 1,440m in H1 FY2026) and prepaid content royalties have been absorbing it.
base.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 10%/2.5% = 13.7x FCF binds below the 15x cap (lower than the 20x house default: a distant #2/#3 player in an oligopoly with a new entrant).

bull.growth_rationale: Subscriber growth re-accelerates to high single digits as paid penetration in China rises toward Tencent Music's ~22% paying ratio, ARPPU dilution ends and membership pricing firms; social entertainment grows modestly again. Peaks at 7.5% and fades to 3%.
bull.margin_rationale: Gross margin reaches ~45% as licensing costs grow slower than subscription revenue (non-exclusive label deals post the 2021 antitrust remedy) and S&M normalises toward 5-6% once Qishui's growth slows; pre-SBC EBITDA matures at 27%.
bull.tax_rationale: HNTE renewed; slower ramp because higher profits are sheltered only slightly longer in absolute terms; long-run 15%.
bull.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 10%/3% = 14.7x binds below the 18x cap.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% because the bear axis is already materialising rather than hypothetical: Qishui Music overtook NetEase on MAU in March 2026 QuestMobile data, H1 FY2026 online-music growth slowed to 3.4% from 12% in FY2025, S&M nearly doubled, and group revenue has been flat for two years; add VIE/regulatory exposure and a 61% controlling holder who could keep the cash onshore indefinitely. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right at once (subscriber re-acceleration, an end to ARPPU dilution, benign label renewals and S&M normalising) and nothing in the H1 FY2026 print points that way. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
